property_summary: For any payable call to receive(), the reference contract increments depositsCount by 1 (so depositsCount increases when nonzero value is sent), whereas the mutant that removed the increment will not increase depositsCount and thus address(c).balance can be >0 while depositsCount did not increase — the reference always keeps depositsCount in sync with received ETH (increments on receive), the mutant breaks that invariant for some deposit value.
change_summary: Replace the increment with no state change by removing the depositsCount update (delete the increment statement).
